verified_facts.text: The resort rises 39 meters above sea level with panoramic views across Ao Yon Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rising 39 meters above sea level with panoramic views across Ao Yon Bay

verified_facts.text: The resort is situated on a private hilltop.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated on a private hilltop, the architecturally-distinctive resort features only 26 private pool villas

verified_facts.text: The private pool villas come in 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6-bedroom configurations.
verified_facts.excerpt: private pool villas available in 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6-bedroom configurations

verified_facts.text: Each villa has personalised 24-hour butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: each with personalised 24-hour butler service

verified_facts.text: The butler can curate in-villa private dining and floating breakfast experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 24-hour Private Personal Butler is on hand to assist with all guest needs, including curating memorable in-villa private dining and floating breakfasts experiences.

verified_facts.text: The 1 Bedroom Sea View Villa has a private infinity pool surrounded by wooden decks with sun loungers.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private infinity pool and comfortable sun loungers are surrounded by spacious wooden decks and merge with the Andaman Sea horizon.

verified_facts.text: The 1 Bedroom Sea View Villa has an en-suite bath with twin spa baths.
verified_facts.excerpt: Villa includes a spacious living room area and a generous bedroom and en-suite bath with twin spa baths.

verified_facts.text: Floor to ceiling windows in the villas give ocean views and a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor to ceiling windows provide spectacular ocean views and offer seamless flow between indoor and outdoor spaces.

verified_facts.text: The 1 Bedroom Hill View Villa looks out over the forested hillside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor to ceiling windows provide serene views of the forested hillside

verified_facts.text: The 4 Bedroom Presidential Hilltop Villa has a gourmet kitchen on the upper level.
verified_facts.excerpt: the two-storey villa features a spacious, light-filled living room, dining room, and gourmet kitchen on the upper level

verified_facts.text: The 4 Bedroom Presidential Hilltop Villa has a personally-curated art gallery and wine cellar reflecting the owner's interests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The owner’s passions and interests are reflected in a personally-curated art gallery and wine cellar.

verified_facts.text: The 6 Bedroom Presidential Beachfront Villa is a three-storey villa situated closest to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated closest to the beach, the 1000sqm, ultra luxurious three-storey beachfront villa offers spectacular ocean and Ao Yon Bay views.

verified_facts.text: The 6 Bedroom Presidential Beachfront Villa has footpath access to Ao Yon Bay beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Footpath access to Ao Yon Bay beach for ocean swims, water activities and sports, and beachside picnics.

verified_facts.text: The 6 Bedroom Presidential Beachfront Villa includes a private sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: ● Private Sauna

verified_facts.text: The resort has an infinity pool with decks and loungers.
verified_facts.excerpt: A magnificent resort infinity pool features spectacular views and ample decks and loungers for day club relaxation

verified_facts.text: V Villas Spa Phuket is nestled in forest canopy and offers treatments using light and Andaman pearl powders.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in tranquil forest canopy, V Villas Spa Phuket delivers bespoke spa treatments and wellness retreats that harness the healing energies of light and Anadman pearl powders.

verified_facts.text: Yon Ocean House serves an all-day menu inspired by European and Thai coastal cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yon \| Ocean House serves an all day menu inspired by European and Thai coastal cuisine and world class wines.
